title: 电动摩托车增加津巴布韦农村妇女的收入
desc: 电动摩托车增加津巴布韦农村妇女的收入

paragraphs.en: Aboard this custom adult-sized tricycle called the Hamba, village healthcare worker Pamhidzi Mutunya delivers medical care that may very well save lives.
paragraphs.zh: 在这辆名为“Hamba”的定制成人三轮车里，乡村医护人员帕姆希齐·穆通亚(Pamhidzi Mutunya)运送着救命的医疗物资。

paragraphs.en: The Hamba made it easier to take patients to and from the hospital.
paragraphs.zh: Hamba使接送病人往返医院变得更容易。

paragraphs.en: Now fewer women give birth at home due to lack of transportation like it used to be.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，由于不像过去那样缺乏交通工具，很少有女性在家分娩了。

paragraphs.en: Mutunya drives an average of four people per day to a health clinic while also picking up medicine for others.
paragraphs.zh: 穆通亚平均每天载四个人去诊所，同时也为其他人取药。

paragraphs.en: She started using a Hamba last year and says women pay about fifteen dollars a month as a group to lease the ride.
paragraphs.zh: 她去年开始驾驶Hamba，并提到女性们以团体形式每月支付大约十五美元的租用费。

paragraphs.en: Hamba pilot coordinator Fadzai Mavhuna: Women in the rural areas carry the burden of carrying firewood, going to fetch water to drink and carrying school kids to school.
paragraphs.zh: Hamba调度者法德扎伊·马夫胡纳说：农村地区的妇女承担着搬运柴火、取饮用水以及送孩子上学的负担。

paragraphs.en: So as Mobility for Africa, we saw that we need to lessen the burden on women.
paragraphs.zh: 作为美力非洲组织，我们认识到需要减轻女性的负担。

paragraphs.en: Transportation start-up Mobility for Africa runs the business side of the Hamba. Drivers say the service change their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 交通初创企业“美力非洲”负责Hamba服务的业务运营。司机们表示，这项服务改变了他们的生活。

paragraphs.en: We used to carry firewood on our heads for two kilometres. Now it's much easier as this tricycle has taken away the burden.
paragraphs.zh: 我们过去常常头顶着柴火走两公里路。现在轻松多了，因为这辆三轮车帮我们减轻了负担。

paragraphs.en: Reusable batteries charged by the sun power the Hamba and fuel it for one dollar or less. It has a cruising range of about a hundred kilometers.
paragraphs.zh: 由太阳充电的可重复使用的电池为Hamba提供动力，其运行成本只需一美元或更少。它大约可以行驶一百公里。

paragraphs.en: The project is targeted to rural women, so we have noticed that it's not everyone who can afford to buy it.
paragraphs.zh: 该项目的目标群体是农村妇女，我们注意到并非每个人都买得起。

paragraphs.en: So we are going to sell it to those who can afford to buy it. But at the same time, we will continually see.
paragraphs.zh: 我们打算把它卖给那些买得起的人。但与此同时，我们会持续关注。

paragraphs.en: Mobility for Africa is now in the second phase of its pilot project.
paragraphs.zh: 美力非洲目前正处于其试点项目的第二阶段。

paragraphs.en: The next step is going commercial where the Hamba will sell for 1,500 dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步是将其商业化，届时Hamba的售价将为1500美元。
